slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Area measures how much surface a region covers, in square units. We accept these area postulates:

Every polygonal region has a unique positive area. Congruent figures have equal area. If a region is cut into non-overlapping pieces, its area is the sum of the areas of the pieces. A square of side 1 has area 1.

So cutting and rearranging keeps area: the seven tangram pieces have the same total area in any arrangement.

slides.html: Two figures have equal areas. Must they be congruent?
slides.reveal: No. A 2 by 8 rectangle and a 4 by 4 square both have area 16.
